tasks.prompt: Complete the Phase 6 core by adding checkpoint-aware cycle continuation. Create src/ade/checkpoint_runtime.py with a provider-agnostic run_checkpointed_cycle(provider, *, task, source_name, store, policy=None, existing_checkpoint=None, start_fn=start_cycle_session, monitor_fn=monitor_cycle_session) API. If there is no recoverable existing checkpoint, start a provider session, persist a RUNNING checkpoint immediately after obtaining the session id, then monitor it. If a valid RUNNING checkpoint for the same task contains a provider_session_id, resume monitoring that existing session without creating a new session. On completion persist COMPLETED. On monitor/start failure, use plan_repair and the checkpoint transition helpers to persist PAUSED_QUOTA/HUMAN_WAIT/REPLAN/FAILED; automatically perform only bounded RETRY dispositions, persisting counters between attempts. Never silently resume HUMAN_WAIT or terminal FAILED checkpoints. Keep secrets and tracebacks out of persisted checkpoints. Return a structured immutable execution result describing the final CycleResult or checkpoint. Export the public API from ade.__init__. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage proving crash-resume with a preseeded RUNNING checkpoint does not call create_session, a fresh run saves RUNNING before monitor, completion saves COMPLETED, quota pause persists, human wait persists, retry is bounded, and mismatched task checkpoints are rejected. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, scripts, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
tasks.title: Add checkpoint-aware cycle continuation

tasks.prompt: Finish the Phase 6 core proof with a deterministic crash/restart continuation probe. Using the public checkpoint, checkpoint store, cycle-session, resume-policy, checkpoint-transition, and checkpoint-runtime APIs created in vertical-slice-010 through vertical-slice-015, add scripts/checkpoint_resume_probe.py and focused standard-library tests. The probe must use a fake provider and a temporary CheckpointStore, simulate an interruption only after a RUNNING checkpoint with provider_session_id has been durably saved, then perform a second invocation that loads that checkpoint and completes by monitoring the same provider session without creating a duplicate session. Assert exactly one provider create_session call across both invocations, a persisted RUNNING checkpoint exists between invocations, the resumed execution reaches COMPLETED, and the final persisted checkpoint is COMPLETED. Print one compact JSON success record and exit 0; invariant failures must exit nonzero without secrets or tracebacks. Keep the probe deterministic and offline. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v and PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/checkpoint_resume_probe.py before finishing.
